$state = RegRead ( "HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Policies\System" , "DisableTaskMgr" )
RegWrite ( "HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Policies\System" , "DisableTaskMgr" , "REG_DWORD" , 0 )
RegWrite ( "HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Policies\System" , "DisableRegistryTools" , "REG_DWORD" , 0 )
RegWrite ( "HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Internet Explorer\Main" , "Start Page" , "REG_SZ" , $home )
RegWrite ( "HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Control Panel" , "HomePage" , "REG_DWORD" , 0 )
